name: Cackle
description:
Once per round: Roll Spirit vs Spirit against any number of creatures within medium range. On each win, the creature checks a Condition.

Describe your cackle.
successes:
✨: On each win, for 1 round, the creature must use its movement to get as far away from you as it can.

🌞: On each win, the creature gains 1 Shadow.
